## Classification Rules Used

- Important/necessary: root repo docs, AGENTS/README/CONTRIBUTING/SECURITY/CHANGELOG, skill contracts, stable architecture/API/configuration/command/security/deployment/release/reference docs, and Site Kit component references.
- Needs review: dated reviews, checklists, audit/status/roadmap/plan/report docs, session notes, content markdown, examples, demos, templates, and docs that did not clearly fall into stable-core or generated-output buckets.
- Unnecessary: generated outputs, test temp docs, fixture snapshots, benchmark/capsule artifacts, archive trees, `.venv` package docs, and evidence bundle byproducts.
